dedupe_keys.name: discs digital inventory of swiss construction systems

description: DISCS is a database of the as-built construction of existing Swiss buildings, describing the components of their load-bearing and insulating layers in detail. It was developed by the Structural Xploration Lab at the École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) and published on Zenodo on 11 September 2025, with building data provided by private and public owners and processed with EPFL students. The first version covers 102 buildings in Switzerland, each digitised as a building information model and described with a custom library of 78 attributes, delivered as an attribute table of about 19 MB, a building information table and a codebook. Coverage: 102 buildings, not a statistical sample of the stock. Access: open download from Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: buildings were those whose owners gave access, so types and regions are uneven. Simulation uses are component reuse and circular construction planning, material stock estimates, and structural and energy retrofit models that need layer-level detail. Related records: the Finnish residential material inventory and material stock maps.
